search_text: published ZDI-21-656 ZDI-CAN-13141 Advantech iView NetworkServlet getPSInventoryInfo SQL Injection Information Disclosure Vulnerability 2021-06-07 CVE-2021-32932 https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2021-32932 7.5 AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:N/A:N ['Advantech'] ['iView'] This vulnerability allows remote attackers to disclose sensitive information on affected installations of Advantech iView. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the NetworkServlet class. title: Advantech iView NetworkServlet getPSInventoryInfo SQL Injection Information Disclosure Vulnerability
vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows remote attackers to disclose sensitive information on affected installations of Advantech iView. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the NetworkServlet class. The issue results from the lack of proper validation of a user-supplied string before using it to construct SQL queries. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to disclose stored credentials, leading to further compromise.
